name: Grey Agnes
text: Pack. The unit after this in the row has Pack and +1 Attack.
golden_text: Pack. The unit after this in the row has Pack and +2 Attack.
details: The next slot in the same row must be occupied; gaps do not move the grant farther. The grant lasts while Agnes is alive beside it.

source.note: Pass 2 review calls in DECISIONS.md take precedence.
